name: Crazy Pineapple
description: Crazy Pineapple is a poker card game that involves betting, hand rankings, bluffing. The game originated in USA and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: Crazy Pineapple is a poker card game that involves betting, hand rankings, bluffing. The game originated in USA and has become popular worldwide.

Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
Three hole cards each, one at a time face down. Then flop (3), turn (1), river (1) to the board.

items.text: Crazy Pineapple Hi-Lo 8 or Better: Pot splits between best high and best qualifying low (8-high or better); each player makes best high and best low from seven cards; aces and straights/flushes count for low.
Fixed Limit vs Pot Limit: Fixed Limit: fixed bet sizes, often doubled on turn and river. Pot Limit: maximum bet or raise equals current pot size.
